description: PCA on dense embeddings and Truncated SVD on sparse TF-IDF. PCA/SVD are feature transforms, not supervised classifiers. Tests whether reducing dimensionality improves or harms downstream classification.

pca_on_embeddings.description: PCA (64 or 128 components) fitted within training folds on MiniLM embeddings; compared against raw 384-d embeddings
pca_on_embeddings.finding: PCA reduces embedding scores; raw 384-d embeddings are best among embedding configs, but still below lexical TF-IDF

truncated_svd.description: TruncatedSVD (100 components) fitted within training folds on sparse TF-IDF; used as dense representation for tree, forest, boosting, KNN, and RBF SVM
truncated_svd.finding: Required for dense models on sparse text; explains representation gap between sparse linear models and dense tree/boosting models

key_finding: PCA/SVD are dimensionality-reduction transforms, not classifiers. They do not produce classification scores on their own; downstream model performance reflects the classifier + transform combination.
